lines.zh: 我慢慢走，草叶替我让路。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and the grass parts for me.

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，踩不坏花。
lines.en: My steps are light and crush no flowers.

lines.zh: 我沿着最矮的草走，好啃。
lines.en: I walk along the shortest grass, easy to nibble.

lines.zh: 走快会累，我不喜欢累。
lines.en: Walking fast tires me. I dislike being tired.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，只是顺路。
lines.en: I follow behind you, only sharing the road.

lines.zh: 这具身体二十七点血，够用了。
lines.en: This body has twenty-seven health. Enough.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，不想磕到脚。
lines.en: I go around the stones to avoid stubbing a foot.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就停下来闻。
lines.en: When the wind blows, I stop to sniff it.

lines.zh: 我走路没声音，连自己都听不见。
lines.en: My walking makes no sound, not even to me.

lines.zh: 前面有片嫩草，我先过去。
lines.en: Tender grass ahead. I will go first.

lines.zh: 慢是慢，方向从不含糊。
lines.en: Slow, but never unsure of the way.

lines.zh: 别催我，我这样走了很久。
lines.en: Do not rush me; I have walked this way a long while.

lines.zh: 我的影子很短，贴着地走。
lines.en: My shadow is short and hugs the ground.

lines.zh: 走到哪儿算哪儿，我不赶时间。
lines.en: I will go as far as I go. No hurry.

lines.zh: 我沿着溪边走，边走边吃。
lines.en: I walk the creek bank, eating as I go.

lines.zh: 草尖扫过我的肚子。
lines.en: Grass tips brush my belly.

lines.zh: 我站着反刍，嘴巴一直在动。
lines.en: I stand and chew, my mouth never still.

lines.zh: 草很甜，这一片我包了。
lines.en: This grass is sweet. This patch is mine.

lines.zh: 我不吵，吵起来会吓到花。
lines.en: I am quiet; noise would frighten the flowers.

lines.zh: 太阳晒在背上，正好。
lines.en: The sun on my back is just right.

lines.zh: 有人靠近，我先看他手里有没有吃的。
lines.en: Someone approaches. First, I check his hands for food.

lines.zh: 我性情温和，但不代表随便摸。
lines.en: I am gentle, but that does not mean pet me.

lines.zh: 我站在这儿，草会自己长回来。
lines.en: I stand here, and the grass regrows by itself.

lines.zh: 二十七点血，我数过，很踏实。
lines.en: Twenty-seven health. I counted. It comforts me.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转了一下，是虫子。
lines.en: My ear turned. It was a bug.

lines.zh: 什么都不做，是我最擅长的事。
lines.en: Doing nothing is what I do best.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，吓自己一跳。
lines.en: I snorted and startled myself.

lines.zh: 这片草地很软，我舍不得走。
lines.en: This meadow is soft. I hate to leave.

lines.zh: 温和的家伙，只想吃点草。
lines.en: A mild fellow — I only want grass.

lines.zh: 我在等草长高一点。
lines.en: I am waiting for the grass to grow a little.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在一块暖石上。
lines.en: I rest my chin on a warm stone.

lines.zh: 有只蝴蝶停在我背上。
lines.en: A butterfly has landed on my back.

lines.zh: 你口袋里的果子很香。
lines.en: The fruit in your pocket smells sweet.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛很圆。
lines.en: I look up at you with round eyes.

lines.zh: 你不是草，也不是石头。
lines.en: You are neither grass nor stone.

lines.zh: 你要摸我吗，先给我点东西。
lines.en: Want to pet me? Offer something first.

lines.zh: 你口袋里有甜根的味道。
lines.en: Your pocket smells of sweet roots.

lines.zh: 你的动作太大，我会退开。
lines.en: Your movements are too big. I will step back.

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，你还没喂我。
lines.en: I have watched you a while. You have not fed me.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我的草了。
lines.en: Your shadow is covering my grass.

lines.zh: 我眨了一下眼，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I blinked once. Consider it a greeting.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，很好。
lines.en: You crouched down. Good.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，只怕空手的人。
lines.en: I fear no one, except the empty-handed.

lines.zh: 你手上有草汁，我记住了。
lines.en: Your hands smell of grass juice; I remember.

lines.zh: 你为什么打我，我没惹你。
lines.en: Why hit me? I did nothing to you.

lines.zh: 我疼，我要跑远一点。
lines.en: That hurts. I will run farther away.

lines.zh: 我身上没有东西给你。
lines.en: I have nothing on me to give you.

lines.zh: 我的短腿抖了一下，没倒。
lines.en: My short legs buckled once, but I stayed up.

lines.zh: 我不还手，我只想活。
lines.en: I will not hit back. I only want to live.

lines.zh: 你打碎了我刚吃的草。
lines.en: You ruined the grass I just ate.

lines.zh: 我流血了，草被染红。
lines.en: I am bleeding. The grass turns red.

lines.zh: 我跑不快，你别追了。
lines.en: I cannot run fast. Please stop chasing.

lines.zh: 同伴都在看我，我很难堪。
lines.en: My herd is watching. I am embarrassed.

lines.zh: 我只是只吃草的，何必呢。
lines.en: I only eat grass. Why do this?

lines.zh: 你手里那束草，我看见了。
lines.en: That bundle of grass in your hand. I see it.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，只跟到吃完为止。
lines.en: I follow you only until the food runs out.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我闻到甜味了。
lines.en: A little closer. I smell something sweet.

lines.zh: 你走三步，我跟三步。
lines.en: You take three steps; I take three.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我就贴着你等。
lines.en: I will not snatch it. I will wait against you.

lines.zh: 食物面前，我的温和会打折。
lines.en: Around food, my gentleness is discounted.

lines.zh: 你举高的手，我看得很紧。
lines.en: I watch that raised hand very closely.

lines.zh: 我鼻子动了，那是答应的意思。
lines.en: My nose twitched. That means yes.

lines.zh: 那束草刚割的，还带着土。
lines.en: That bundle of grass is freshly cut — still earthy.

lines.zh: 有吃的，我连陌生人也不怕。
lines.en: With food, I fear even strangers not at all.

lines.zh: 你把草放下，我们就成了朋友。
lines.en: Set the grass down and we are friends.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，是因为你手里香。
lines.en: I follow because your hands smell good.

lines.zh: 这一口吃完，我就跟你走。
lines.en: After this bite, I will come with you.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我先舔一下。
lines.en: Reach out, and I will lick your hand first.

lines.zh: 你把草举到胸前，太高了。
lines.en: You hold the grass too high.

lines.zh: 吃完这口，我再决定跟不跟。
lines.en: One more bite, then I decide.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像撞到一袋草。
lines.en: You bumped into me like a sack of grass.

lines.zh: 我侧身让了让，你没看见。
lines.en: I shifted aside. You did not notice.

lines.zh: 别推我，我不喜欢被推。
lines.en: Do not shove me. I dislike being shoved.

lines.zh: 我这么温顺，你还撞我。
lines.en: I am this gentle, and still you bump me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪开，一点也不生气。
lines.en: I shuffle aside without a trace of anger.

lines.zh: 你踩到我脚了，我挪开了。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot. I moved it.

lines.zh: 我不顶人，顶人不是我的事。
lines.en: I do not headbutt. That is not my way.

lines.zh: 挤在一起暖和，我不介意。
lines.en: Huddling together is warm. I do not mind.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我还在原地嚼。
lines.en: When you stepped back, I was still chewing.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我掉了半口草。
lines.en: That bump cost me half a mouthful.

lines.zh: 春天到了，我会去找同伴。
lines.en: Spring comes, and I go looking for company.

lines.zh: 我用食物换来的，不只是跟随。
lines.en: What I trade for food is more than following.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣闻起来像青草。
lines.en: My mate smells of green grass.

lines.zh: 我们低头吃草，谁也不说话。
lines.en: We graze head down, neither speaking.

lines.zh: 后代生下来就会找奶。
lines.en: The young are born knowing where to nurse.

lines.zh: 我不争，伴侣自己会选。
lines.en: I do not fight. My mate chooses on her own.

lines.zh: 两只挨着走，比一只安心。
lines.en: Two walking together feel safer than one.

lines.zh: 繁殖的季节，我脾气会好一点。
lines.en: In breeding season my temper improves.

lines.zh: 你走开些，这是我们的事。
lines.en: Step away. This is our business.

lines.zh: 幼崽很软，我守着它吃草。
lines.en: The calf is soft. I guard it while it grazes.

lines.zh: 地上有草，我低头就吃。
lines.en: Grass on the ground. I lower my head and eat.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我直接吃。
lines.en: I do not pick things up. I eat them.

lines.zh: 你掉的苹果，我闻到了。
lines.en: You dropped an apple. I smelled it.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我一口就叼稳。
lines.en: One bite and I have it steady.

lines.zh: 这朵花我咬了一口，不好吃。
lines.en: I bit this flower. Not tasty.

lines.zh: 这朵花咬了一口，不好吃。
lines.en: I bit this flower once — it was not good.

lines.zh: 我把草根拱出来，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I root up grass and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里掉的，我也敢捡。
lines.en: Even what falls from your hand, I dare take.

lines.zh: 我叼着东西走不快，但很稳。
lines.en: Carrying something slows me, but I am steady.

lines.zh: 这块叶子够我嚼半天。
lines.en: This leaf will keep me chewing half a day.

lines.zh: 灌木那边有影子在晃。
lines.en: A shadow sways beyond the bushes.

lines.zh: 我不找目标，我只找草。
lines.en: I seek no target, only grass.

lines.zh: 那边响了一声，我先退两步。
lines.en: Something sounded there. I step back two paces.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我记住你了。
lines.en: You stand too close. I have noted you.

lines.zh: 我的注意力很短，一下就没。
lines.en: My attention is short and gone in a moment.

lines.zh: 那东西比草大，我不靠近。
lines.en: That thing is bigger than grass. I keep away.

lines.zh: 我耳朵朝那边转了。
lines.en: My ears turned that way.

lines.zh: 我看见了，但我不打算管。
lines.en: I saw it. I do not plan to care.

lines.zh: 有危险的味道，我慢慢走开。
lines.en: That smells of danger. I walk off slowly.

lines.zh: 我盯了一会儿，还是决定吃草。
lines.en: I stared a while, then chose the grass.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的草。
lines.en: I am staring at the grass in your hand.

lines.zh: 你要是不动，我就当你无害。
lines.en: If you stay still, I count you harmless.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，靠近那片叶子。
lines.en: One slow step at a time, toward that leaf.

lines.zh: 我迈半步，再迈半步。
lines.en: I take half a step, then another.

lines.zh: 我只盯着吃的，别的看不见。
lines.en: I watch only food and see nothing else.

lines.zh: 我的目标很简单：那口嫩芽。
lines.en: My target is simple: that tender sprout.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我先缩一下脖子。
lines.en: You raise a hand; I duck my neck first.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，去够那片叶子。
lines.en: I go around you to reach that leaf.

lines.zh: 盯久了，我会打瞌睡。
lines.en: Stare long enough and I doze off.

lines.zh: 我不擅长追，只擅长等。
lines.en: I am poor at chasing and good at waiting.

lines.zh: 我不会打架，我只会躲。
lines.en: I do not fight. I only avoid.

lines.zh: 你逼急了，我最多顶一下。
lines.en: Push me far enough and I nudge once.

lines.zh: 我的力气都用在嚼草上。
lines.en: All my strength goes into chewing grass.

lines.zh: 这一下没什么力道，别介意。
lines.en: That had little force. Do not mind it.

lines.zh: 我踢了一下，自己先退了。
lines.en: I kicked once and retreated first.

lines.zh: 我连角都没有，拿什么打。
lines.en: I have no horns. What would I fight with?

lines.zh: 你受伤了，我不是故意的。
lines.en: You got hurt. It was not on purpose.

lines.zh: 我只想把你从草上赶开。
lines.en: I only want you off my grass.

lines.zh: 温顺不是不会反抗。
lines.en: Gentle does not mean defenseless.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我喘了很久。
lines.en: After that one hit, I panted a long time.

lines.zh: 我出生在一片草地里。
lines.en: I was born in a meadow.

lines.zh: 我从草窝里站起来，找嫩叶。
lines.en: I rise from my grass nest to look for tender leaves.

lines.zh: 我的腿还软，站了两次才起来。
lines.en: My legs were weak; it took two tries to stand.

lines.zh: 周围都是草香，我很安心。
lines.en: Grass scent everywhere. I feel safe.

lines.zh: 二十七点血，够我活很久。
lines.en: Twenty-seven health will last me a long while.

lines.zh: 我不记得怎么来的，只记得饿。
lines.en: I do not recall arriving, only being hungry.

lines.zh: 有同伴在旁边，我不怕。
lines.en: My kind are nearby. I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 这片地方安静，适合长大。
lines.en: This place is quiet, good for growing up.

lines.zh: 我一站起来就开始啃草。
lines.en: The moment I stood, I started grazing.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己不会掉东西。
lines.en: I do not know that I drop nothing.

lines.zh: 火烫到我的背，我滚了一圈。
lines.en: Fire caught my back; I rolled once.

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下，草接住了我。
lines.en: I fell down a slope, and the grass caught me.

lines.zh: 水没到脖子，我拼命往岸上走。
lines.en: Water reached my neck; I struggled to shore.

lines.zh: 响声太大，我四条腿都在抖。
lines.en: The blast was so loud my legs shook.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我身上，我扯不掉。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in me and I cannot pull it out.

lines.zh: 那道光碰到我，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: That light touched me and my whole body numbed.

lines.zh: 我饿了，眼前都是草。
lines.en: I am hungry. I see grass everywhere.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我旁边，我吓呆了。
lines.en: Lightning struck beside me. I froze.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，什么都抓不住。
lines.en: I fell down and could not grab anything.
